name: HideEyes_1
short_caption: The robot playfully hides its eyes behind its hands, first with its right hand, then its left hand, before returning to a neutral stance.
movement_description: The robot begins in a neutral pose and lifts its right hand to cover its eyes, holding the position briefly before lowering it. It then raises its left hand to cover its eyes in a similar peek-a-boo fashion. Finally, it drops its left hand and smoothly transitions back to the initial neutral standing posture.
safety_notes: The robot raises both arms near its face; ensure there is clearance around the head and upper torso area.
